## Reflection
My goal in this class is to work towards a better understanding of microprocessors and the sensors that they countrol. I have concentrated my work at Mudd in biomedical research, projects, and classes, and I hope to apply microps to that area. Sensors are integral to the biomedical field and learning how to implement them with a microcontroller is something that I hope to do for my final project as well as further on in my career.
